title: Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program Multi-Mission Dry Dock, Multiple Award Construction Contract
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVFAC > NAVFAC PACIFIC CMD > NAVFAC NORTHWEST NW > NAVFACSYSCOM NORTHWEST
description: Title: SIOP MMDD MACC. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) has a requirement to provide predominantly construction services (design build (DB) and design-bid-build (DBB)) for heavy and civil engineering waterfront facilities as well as commercial and institutional facilities primarily in support of the Shipyard Infrastructure Optimization Program (SIOP) Multi-Mission Dry Dock (MMDD) at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS and IMF), located at Naval Base Kitsap (NBK) Bremerton, Washington and other areas under the cognizance of NAVFAC Pacific. This solicitation will result in the award of Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Construction Contracts (MACC). The period of performance will be a base period of 5-years and one (1) 5-year option period for a maximum possible duration of 10-years; or an aggregate maximum estimated value of $15,000,000,000 for all task orders, whichever occurs first. The typical size of major construction task orders will range from $2,000,000,000 to $6,000,000,000; however, smaller task orders may be issued to support smaller efforts such as Early Contractor Involvement (ECI) and/or Alternative Technical Concepts (ATC). Task orders may be above this limit; however, contractors are not obligated to accept such task orders under the general terms of the contract. Each MACC holder will receive a minimum guarantee in the amount of $1,000,000. This solicitation is unrestricted allowing for full and open competition. Large businesses are advised that an acceptable small business subcontracting plan is required. Primary North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction; Small Business Size Standard: $45M.Secondary NAICS code 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction; Small Business Size Standard: $45M. Amendment 0001- Issued 21 October 2026. Amendment 0002- Issued 28 October 2026. Amendment 0003- Issued 05 November 2026. Amendment 0004- Issued 19 November 2026.
